description: Electricity demand data in a Lebanese village: Households, industrial sites and a municipality is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Haytham Dbouk, Majd Olleik (American University of Beirut). This dataset owned by the American University of Beirut (AUB) was collected by Innovating Green Technology (IGT) as part of the project “From Off-grid Solar PV Systems to Microgrids in Lebanon”. Coverage: national (LB); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
